description: Error shown when the global instructions draft is larger than the 1 MiB Core accepts; saving is disabled.
en-US: Global instructions must be no larger than 1 MiB.
zh-CN: 全局指令不得超过 1 MiB。

description: Title of the dialog that asks before a reload replaces an edited instructions draft.
Body of the discard-draft confirmation.
en-US: Reloading replaces this draft with the current file contents.
zh-CN: 重新加载会用文件当前内容替换这份草稿。

Title of the card that checks Node.js and npm and installs or uninstalls the selected Agent's adapter.
Help text of the environment and adapter card. Lithe installs only the ACP adapter; the Agent's CLI is not changed.
en-US: Check Node.js and npm, then install or uninstall this Agent's ACP adapter. Lithe does not change the Agent's own CLI.
zh-CN: 检查 Node.js 与 npm，然后安装或卸载此 Agent 的 ACP 适配器。Lithe 不会改动 Agent 自身的 CLI。

Note on the hooks page when Codex is selected: Codex needs Hooks enabled and commands trusted in its own /hooks screen; saving does not grant trust.
en-US: Codex requires Hooks to be enabled and commands to be trusted in its native /hooks screen. Lithe saves configuration without granting trust. Editing a command requires approval again. A configured Hook is not proof it ran.
zh-CN: Codex 需要在它自己的 /hooks 界面中启用 Hook 并信任命令。Lithe 只保存配置，不授予信任。修改命令后需要重新批准。已配置的 Hook 不代表它已经运行。

description: Help under the Hook timeout field: empty uses the Agent default, otherwise 1 to 86400 seconds.
en-US: Leave empty to use the Agent default, or enter an integer from 1 to 86400.
zh-CN: 留空则使用 Agent 的默认值，或输入 1 到 86400 之间的整数。
